# Lending Policy Updates and Risk Management

This document details critical updates and optimizations required for the bank's lending policy.

## Key Action Items:

*   Update the default risk assessment quarterly.
*   Optimize collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Monitor standard updates for collateral value.
*   Investigate standard updates for default risk.
*   Optimize default risk assessments quarterly.
